## Synchrony Bank Deposit Products

## High-Yield Savings

A savings account designed for interest earnings, with public materials describing no minimum balance and no monthly service fee.

## Money Market

A deposit account with interest earnings and access features subject to the product terms.

## Certificates of Deposit

Synchrony offers CDs across multiple terms; the public comparison page includes standard CDs and a Bump-Up CD.

## Bump-Up CD

The public product page describes a rate-increase option once during the term if the offered Bump-Up rate rises.

## IRAs

Synchrony's public filings identify IRA deposit products as part of its deposit-product range.

Promotions vary by card, merchant, purchase amount, duration and offer structure. A promotional offer should never be assumed to apply universally.

APR, minimum interest charges, late fees and other terms can change for new accounts or differ by product. Existing customers should rely on their agreements.

A Synchrony-branded network card is not automatically accepted by every merchant in the category.

This reference was compiled from public Synchrony/CareCredit materials reviewed in September 2026. Product names, partner relationships, pricing, promotional terms and service availability can change.

A full credit application can involve a credit inquiry and is subject to credit approval.

## Decision flow

Applications may be completed online, in-store, through merchant devices or through partner integrations.

## Program-specific terms

The credit product, merchant, purchase amount, promotional offer and credit profile influence the final available financing terms.

## Program structure

A private-label card can be restricted to the sponsoring brand/program. Some programs are dual-branded or have broader network acceptance depending on the product.

## Important distinction

Promotional financing is not a single universal Synchrony term. The exact promotion, qualifying purchase amount, interest treatment, duration and minimum payments depend on the individual program.

Primary public source: https://www.synchrony.com/business/financing-solutions

## Synchrony Network Cards

## Network concept

A Synchrony-branded network card is designed around a category or industry rather than one retailer. Participating merchants accept the network card within the relevant ecosystem.

## Publicly listed networks

Synchrony Car Care, CareCredit, Synchrony HOME, Synchrony Home Improvement, Synchrony Luxury, Synchrony Music & Sound, Synchrony Outdoors, Synchrony Project Card, Synchrony Sewing & More and Synchrony Sport.
